description: BD Transaction silver merge - convert the transaction bronze files (TRANSACTIONS_DAILY_*, landed by the live 49F REST session chain) to silver parquet. The Playwright portal download this document used to run is removed: BD added MFA and it failed every run since 2026-06-23.

runCommand: echo "=== BD Transaction silver merge - $TODAY ===" | tee $LOG
# NO PORTAL LOGIN AND NO PORTAL CREDENTIALS, BY DESIGN. The Playwright portal download that stood
# here failed every run since Black Diamond added MFA (~2026-06-23; 21 of 21 on this leg). The
# transaction bronze is landed daily by the live 49F REST session chain as TRANSACTIONS_DAILY_*,
# and the merge below already reads it. Order NFRA_MCPINDEX MX-s-14, amendment A1.
# Run transaction silver conversion - capture exit code
aws s3 cp s3://opal-data-bd/code/silver/merge-daily-incremental.py . 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG || echo 'WARNING: Script download failed' | tee -a $LOG
# Arm the shutdown BEFORE the failure branch. The `exit 1` below is what makes SSM report the
# truth, but an exit that PRECEDES the shutdown strands this t3.medium on every failing run, and
# no CloudWatch auto-stop exists for it (NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-S17). Same order as
# Exit non-zero if the merge failed so SSM and CloudWatch reflect the failure
